title: White Dove | 30A Vacation Rental | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: White Dove is a breathtaking 30A Vacation Rental that boasts pure luxury and beauty. A stay at this impressive property with luxury amenities is a dream come true! Reserve now!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Exceptional in its beauty, luxury, and serenity, White Dove is a breathtaking property in 30A's most storied community. Artfully designed by Benecki Homes with Wolf and Subzero appliances, a butler's pantry, two wet bars, a master bedroom breakfast bar, spectacular master closets, and a spacious third-floor recreation room - one of three gathering spaces across the home's generously appointed three levels. The attention to detail is evident in its exceptional tile selections, custom cabinetry, natural quartz countertops and Venetian plaster walls throughout the home's first floor, evoking feelings of relaxed elegance that truly epitomizes the 30A lifestyle.

Even more impressive, though, is what greets guests on entry. A grand oval vestibule connects to a superbly decorated light-filled formal dining room and opposite it, a sublimely designed study. Continuing through the home's central corridor reveals the main living area that is grand in size yet thoughtful in scale. Reclaimed ceiling beams direct the eye to a beautiful veranda that boasts a summer kitchen, built-in grille, and plenty of room for dining made for year-round gatherings. Just steps away is a breathtaking view of one of the largest private pools in Rosemary Beach. On the second floor, you'll find European white oak across a 15'x22' sitting area that connects the floor's 3 bedrooms, each complete with its own full bathroom and plenty of finished storage. The third floor adds a spacious bunk room with 4 queen-size beds - the perfect place for the kids to rest after an enjoyable day at the beach. You will also find an expansive recreation area including a ping-pong table, wet bar, and oversized couch, offering an ideal location for family game nights or a cozy home theatre experience.

The property's carriage house offers 770 more square feet of living area, across a main floor and a loft bedroom allowing for guest privacy in a comfortable, oversized lockout apartment. White Dove is the perfect blend of sophistication and relaxed coastal elegance. This residence is ideal for those wanting to be in Rosemary Beach while enjoying the privacy this extraordinary estate affords.

**Property rents Saturday to Saturday during Spring Break and Summer seasons.
Pool can be heated October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $575**
